title: Man nailed himself inside a box to escape slavery in 1849
summary_full: Henry Box Brown escaped slavery in 1849 by having himself packed inside a wooden box and transported from Richmond, Virginia, to Philadelphia. The 26-27-hour journey involved several changes of transport, and the box was turned upside down twice, nearly costing him his life. After reaching freedom, Brown became an abolitionist speaker and performer, sharing his escape story across the US and England. He later returned to the US and died in Toronto in 1897.
